confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for Rimini in July peak season, with no live price checks. Beer, coffee, and restaurant anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because summer accommodation prices vary widely. The FX value (0.6955 for 2026-10-15) came from a search summary attributed to the RBA; I could not re-verify it on the RBA table, so confirm it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other Italian Adriatic and Riviera Romagnola seaside resort towns with similar summer tourism demand and price levels, adjusted for Rimini's peak-July accommodation premium.
